title: fix(plugin-view): the host delegation reads a named view's remaining protocol members off the named view (objectui#10758)
body:
Fixes #10758
Clause-②: no

Claim `5861950053`, seat `domain:ui#4`, PM session `session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY` (`https://claude.ai/code/session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`). This is bucket ① of the objectui#7924 ruling (`5690906005`). `densityMode` and `allowExport` stay excluded, per the re-ruling `5852199633` as amended by `5856690997`.

## Re-sample (step 1), on objectui `origin/main` `de1b879`

Each reading was taken off disk and off the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0. A scratch script walked the spec schema, parsed the `NamedListView` interface with the TypeScript parser, and parsed both host literals. The types census re-derives the same partition on every run.

- **The protocol's named view.** `ObjectListViewSchema` declares 50 keys. Five of them are retirement tombstones, so 45 are live. `NamedListView` declares 64 members, and every one of the 45 live protocol keys is among them.
- **What the renderer read off a named view: 20 names.** They are `appearance`, `calendar`, `chart`, `columns`, `data`, `fieldOrder`, `filter`, `gallery`, `gantt`, `grouping`, `kanban`, `label`, `map`, `name`, `rowColor`, `sort`, `timeline`, `tree`, `type` and `userActions`.
  - The card says 21. PR objectui#10821 removed the `options` read after the card was filed, and `options` is not a protocol key.
  - The delegation itself (the `renderListView` literal) read 10 of the 20. Eight are read inside the fence: `label`, `columns`, `grouping`, `userActions`, `rowColor`, `data`, `fieldOrder` and `appearance`. `filter` and `sort` are read upstream, in `authoredFilters` and `mergedSort`.
- **Bucket ①: 23 protocol members that no route read off a named view.** These are the ruling's count and the ruling's names: `addRecord`, `allowPrinting`, `aria`, `bulkActionDefs`, `bulkActions`, `compactToolbar`, `conditionalFormatting`, `description`, `emptyState`, `exportOptions`, `filterableFields`, `hiddenFields`, `inlineEdit`, `navigation`, `pagination`, `resizable`, `rowActions`, `rowHeight`, `searchableFields`, `selection`, `sharing`, `showRecordCount` and `userFilters`.
  - `tabs` and `pageName` are also unread. They stay out because objectui#8980 ruled them declared-inert.
- **The delegation's rungs for these 23, before this PR.**
  - 19 read the host `views` entry, then the node (`activeView?.X ?? (schema as any).X`).
  - `rowHeight` read the host entry through the density fold.
  - `description`, `exportOptions` and `bulkActionDefs` had no rung at all.
- **App-shell's object page relay drops none of the 23.**
  - 22 have a rung that reads its active view (`viewDef.X`).
  - `compactToolbar` arrives through the plugin-view composition. `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559.test.ts` records it as relayed upstream.
  - So `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` is not touched (N4). App-shell hands its named view to plugin-view as the host `views` entry, not as `listViews`.
- **The consumer (N3).** `ListView` reads all 23 off the `list-view` node it is handed.
  - Most are read directly.
  - Seven are forwarded to the `object-grid` that ListView renders, and `ObjectGrid` reads each one: `pagination`, `selection`, `resizable`, `rowActions`, `bulkActions` (as `batchActions`), `bulkActionDefs` and `conditionalFormatting`.
  - No member reaches the node without a reader, so N3 has no declared-not-enforced gap to list.

## What changed

- **`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`**, in the `renderListView({ schema: { … } })` literal inside the objectui#5097 HOST-COMPOSITION fence. Each of the 23 rungs now reads the active named view first (`currentNamedViewConfig?.X`). Then it reads the host `views` entry, and then the node, but only where the rung already read the node. This is the precedence `grouping`, `rowColor` and `appearance` use.
  - The three new rungs (`description`, `exportOptions`, `bulkActionDefs`) read the two views only. They never read the node.
  - A named view's `rowHeight` is read as itself: the strict record refuses `densityMode`, so there is nothing to fold. The host entry still goes through the fold (ruling A′).
  - ⛔ No rung gained a `(schema as any)` read, so the objectui#5097 exemption stays at 27 names. ⛔ No alias and no non-protocol key is read off the named view.
- **What moves for a host.** Only a host that supplies both `listViews` and its own `renderListView` sees a change.
  - Where the active named view and the host `views` entry both carry one of these members, the named view's value now wins.
  - A named view that carries none of them hands down exactly what it did before.
  - The registered `object-view` renderer passes no `renderListView`, so an authored node is unaffected.
- **Changeset**: `10758-named-view-protocol-members.md`, `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-view`.

## Beyond the claimed file surface, and why

1. **`packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`**, the types census. It pins every bucket-① member UNREAD by name, so the change turns it red by construction. Every pin that held one of these members unread is inverted. ⛔ None is deleted.
   - The census moves from 20 read / 44 unread to 43 read / 21 unread.
   - Bucket ① is asserted EMPTY, derived rather than listed. The 23 names are kept as the pinned reading of what moved, one READ assertion each.
   - The census's negative twin moves from `rowHeight` to `allowExport`, which is read off the host entry and the node and not off a named view.
   - The absence pin for `bulkActionDefs` / `exportOptions` becomes a read pin that also holds "no node read".
   - The `densityMode` pin and the two `READ_TEXT` rows follow the new rung text.
2. **`packages/plugin-view/README.md`** and **`content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`** each gain one prose paragraph describing the host-path precedence. This follows the docs-driven rule (AGENTS.md section 5, #2). Neither file gains a code fence.

## Pins, one named view per member family

- **`ObjectView.namedViewProtocolKeys-8980.test.tsx`**, a new route-3 block. There are four families: list chrome (7), record actions (6), grid presentation (6), and search, filter and navigation (4). Each family runs four cases:
  - the named view parses under the strict `ObjectListViewSchema`, so every value is one a conforming author can write;
  - **THE FIX**: the named view's value reaches the `list-view` node the host renders, and wins over the host entry and the node;
  - **CONTROL**: with the family absent from the named view, the host entry supplies it;
  - **CONTROL**: with neither view declaring it, the node supplies it. The four rungs with no node read stay `undefined`.
  - The members already read (`label`, `columns`, `fieldOrder`, `grouping`) ride every fixture as the firing control. A last case holds `rowHeight`: the named value is read as itself, and the host entry's retired spelling still arrives through the fold.
- **`objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx`**, a new section 1b, derived with the TypeScript parser over the fence only:
  - the named-view read set inside the fence, by name;
  - the property that every rung for a protocol member reads the named view, except `type` (node identity) and `filter` / `sort` (read upstream);
  - no named-view read of a key the protocol does not declare there, with `allowExport` as the control;
  - no new cast read.
- **"The rendered view" here is the `list-view` node that the host's `renderListView` receives.** A plugin-view test cannot import `ListView`: `@object-ui/plugin-list` is not a plugin-view dependency, and `check:phantom-deps` refuses the import. The link from that node to the rendered list is `ListView`'s own reads, listed under N3 above.

## Verification at `5dc80e3`

Every heavy run went through `os-verify-lock.sh`, and each exit code was captured redirect-first.

- **vitest `packages/plugin-view/`** plus the types census: 53 files, 745 tests passed, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **vitest on the tests that read the three changed markdown files** (from `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --list`), every app-shell `ObjectView*` test (the relay census included) and `StudioDesignSurface.gridRefresh`: 58 files, 1243 tests passed, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **`type-check`**, exit 0 for `@object-ui/plugin-view` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) and for `@object-ui/types` (plus `tsconfig.examples.json`). `--listFilesOnly` confirms the three edited test files are in those programs.
- **ESLint `--no-inline-config`** on the 4 edited TS/TSX files, which is the whole population: `eslint.config.js` covers them with `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`, and `--format json` reports 4 files.
  - 0 errors and 86 warnings, per file identical to the base (60 / 26 / 0 / 0).
  - Not type-aware: `projectService` / `parserOptions` count 0 against a `languageOptions` control of 1. So no untouched file's verdict can move.
- **Gates**, exit 0 each:
  - `check-changeset-presence` (4 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, and `check-changeset-claims` (report-only; the six pending paragraphs it names were read and are still true);
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, and the three `check:vi-mock-*` gates;
  - `check:spec-symbols` and `check:phantom-deps`;
  - `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check-doc-links` and `check:doc-example-readers`;
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 7 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- **NOT MEASURED:**
  - `check:readme-exports`: prerequisite not met (the workspace dists are not built). This diff adds no fenced block to any README.
  - `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples`: not run, because no fenced block was added.
  - The full `@object-ui/types` suite: only a test file changed there, and that file and the types tests that read the changed markdown ran.
  - The full app-shell suite and the Spec Main Shape Gate: CI runs them.

## Reverse verification

Run once on the committed tree `59046a2` with `ablation-replace.mjs`. The whole HOST-COMPOSITION fence was replaced by its base text; the mutated blob `e1e9557` equals the base blob. The directions were predicted before the run.

- **Result: 64 failed, 225 passed.**
  - 8980 pin: 7 red. These are the four THE FIX cases, the host-entry CONTROL of the two families holding a new rung, and the `rowHeight` case.
  - Host-surface pin: 3 red.
  - Census: 54 red. These are the 23 READ rows, the 23 BUCKET ① → READ rows, the counts, the partition, bucket ① empty, the inverted absence pin, the `densityMode` pin and the two `READ_TEXT` rows.
- **The predicted-green controls stayed green**: the host CONTROL of the other two families, all four node CONTROLs, the four protocol parses, the off-protocol pin, the 21 UNREAD rows, and the bucket ② / ③ rows.
- **One prediction missed.** The four-way partition test stayed green. It partitions the pinned literal, and the link from literal to derivation is the "43 read + 21 unread" test, which went red.
- **The restore was proven**: the blob equals HEAD (`89b6c7e`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- The later commits (`2960ef6`, `5dc80e3`) touch only a test title and the types of the probe helper. No assertion moved.

## Acceptance notes

- **Reach, measured on this tree.** No in-tree host passes both `listViews` and `renderListView`. App-shell's object page passes its named view as the host `views` entry, and the Studio grid passes neither. So the new rungs serve an out-of-tree host that composes both, which is the same reach as the objectui#8980 rungs beside them. This is recorded, not claimed wider.
- **Route 2 (the registered renderer's grid path) still reads only `columns`, `filter`, `sort`, `grouping` and `rowColor` off a named view.**
  - A scratch probe, not committed: `ObjectView` without `renderListView`, which is exactly what the registered renderer mounts. A named grid view authored `pagination`, `selection`, `hiddenFields`, `rowHeight`, `conditionalFormatting`, `rowActions`, `bulkActions` and `resizable`, and the `object-grid` schema carried `columns` only. `ObjectGrid` reads each of those keys.
  - This is outside the claimed literal: the ruling sends bucket ① to "the `object-view` delegation".
  - ⚠️ The types census counts a member as read when ANY route reads it, so bucket ① now reads empty while route 2 still ignores these members.
  - No real producer was found: no authored `object-view` node with `listViews` in either repository.
  - Reported to the PM, not filed.
- **The delegation does not relay a named view's eight view-kind blocks** (`kanban`, `calendar`, `gallery`, `timeline`, `gantt`, `map`, `chart`, `tree`). Only `options: activeView` goes down, while `ListView` reads top-level `schema.kanban` and the others.
  - The same probe: a named `type: 'kanban'` view with `kanban: { groupByField: 'stage' }` handed the host `viewType: 'kanban'` and `columns`, and no `kanban`.
  - These members are counted read (route 1), so they are not bucket ①.
  - Same reach as above. Reported, not filed.
